Interface PlayerInventory<Self extends PlayerInventory<Self>>

Type Parameters:
Self - The interface holding the implementation
All Superinterfaces:
DataHolder<Self>, Inventory, InventoryView<Self>
All Known Subinterfaces:
PlayerInventory.Changing, PlayerInventory.Mutable
public interface PlayerInventory<Self extends PlayerInventory<Self>> extends InventoryView<Self>
The player inventory. This is attached to the Connection. While this is not the visible inventory (instead that is EntityInventory) by default this will update the visible inventory
